caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical bucket with a wide opening at the top and a pair of thick, arched handles attached to metal rings on either side. The bucket is primarily red in color, with shaded and textured areas suggesting wear, creases, and age. Around the upper and lower rims of the bucket, as well as along the handles, there are rows of evenly spaced, round metal studs or rivets, rendered in a dull brass or bronze tone. On the front surface of the bucket, there is a large yellowish number "4" with a dark shadow, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present. At the bottom center, the signature "John Cooke 1938" is written.
title: Fire Bucket
